description: Change settings on an existing version instead of creating a new one: point it at a new image tag, turn it on or off, change max_duration, set the registry login, turn on image caching (force_cache: Edgegap pre-loads the image so deployments start faster), or set the shutdown grace period. Only the fields you pass change. Deployments already running keep their old settings; new deployments get the new ones. Same refusals as edgegap_create_app_version: "latest" or empty tags, a docker_image holding a host or tag, and the API token in the registry login or env vars. ports and env REPLACE the version's whole list (per the API): read the current ones with edgegap_get_app_version and pass every port or variable to keep; secret env values are not readable, so get them from the developer. Refused, with nothing sent, for a registry login or env value equal to the API's "This value is set and encrypted" placeholder; leave the registry login out to keep it. cpu_units and memory_mb change together (both or neither); to try other resources for one deployment only, override them in edgegap_deploy instead.

cpu_units.description: New vCPU units for later deployments, with memory_mb. 1024 = 1 vCPU.

docker_tag.description: New image tag: a build ID, commit SHA or timestamp.

dry_run.description: Show the exact request (method, host, path, body) with secrets masked, and send nothing. Local checks still run. Use it to confirm a billable or destructive call before making it.

endpoint_storage.description: Endpoint Storage name (edgegap_list_endpoint_storage) to export container logs to when deployments end.

env.description: REPLACES every env var on the version; [] removes them all. Values are never echoed back.

force_cache.description: Pre-load the image on Edgegap so deployments start faster.

is_active.description: false blocks new deployments of this version.

max_duration_minutes.description: Auto-stop after this many minutes. Capped by EDGEGAP_MAX_DURATION_MINUTES.

memory_mb.description: New memory in MB for later deployments, with cpu_units. At most 2x cpu_units.

ports.description: REPLACES every port on the version. Include the ports to keep, not only new ones.

protocol.description: One of UDP, TCP, TCP/UDP, HTTP, HTTPS, WS, WSS. Most game servers use UDP.

tls_upgrade.description: wss:// / https:// for browser clients. WS and HTTP ports only.

to_check.description: Readiness check on this port. Default true.

registry_token.description: Registry password or token. Never echoed back.

termination_grace_period_seconds.description: Seconds between SIGTERM and SIGKILL when a deployment stops.

verify_image.description: Check Edgegap can pull the image when saving.

name: edgegap_update_app_version
title: Update an application version
